note: Web searches of 23/11/2026 for the 20 dossier zones of run-mars-001 (protocol mars-v1, section 5). Rule fixed before reading the results: a match needs a source naming the place itself as an analog of the target environment (ice-rich mid-latitude ground or polar terrain), or describing its relief as the target's slope profile does at the MOLA scale; regional descriptions or analogs of another environment give no match. A match is my judgement. No finding was used to rank or remove a zone. Some queries grouped several places; they are recorded as run.
